description: NEW RENTER DISCOUNT - $100 OFF BOOKING Perched along a quiet and scenic stretch of Benner Road in Bristol, right on the edge of Damariscotta, the historic Hinsdale House offers a unique blend of early Maine heritage and modern comfort. Built in 1820—the same year Maine achieved statehood—this charming home has been thoughtfully preserved, allowing its rich history to shine through in every detail. Now owned by a writer and a museum curator, the home is beautifully adorned with folk art and paintings collected from across New England, creating a warm, curated atmosphere that feels both timeless and inviting.
